header.label: Comparison
header.title: OpenAEC vs AutoCAD LT
header.desc: Open CAD Studio is an open source CAD application for 2D drafting and 3D modelling, built in Rust, with native DWG and DXF. Compare it to AutoCAD LT on features, pricing, platforms and license.

intro.p1: AutoCAD LT is the streamlined 2D version of Autodesk's iconic AutoCAD, first released in 1993. It's the de facto standard for 2D drafting in architecture, civil engineering and building services, with a deep ecosystem of plug-ins, families and exchange formats. AutoCAD LT typically costs €500-700 per user per year (subscription, annual or multi-year).
intro.p2: Open CAD Studio is an open source CAD application for 2D drafting, layouts and 3D solids. It opens and saves DWG and DXF natively (DWG R14 through 2018), without a conversion service. It is a community project by independent developer Hakan Seven; the OpenAEC Foundation counts it as part of its ecosystem, and Open Infra Studio builds on it. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and in the browser without installation. License: GPL-3.0.

openaec.title: Choose Open CAD Studio if...
openaec.item1: You don't want to pay a €500-700 annual subscription for basic 2D drafting.
openaec.item2: You work on Linux, or want to draw right in the browser.
openaec.item3: You want to open and save DWG drawings without vendor lock-in.
openaec.item4: You want to model 3D solids next to 2D, which AutoCAD LT cannot do.
openaec.item5: You are a freelancer, student or small office that needs professional CAD tools.
openaec.item6: You want to automate tasks with scripts or an AI assistant through MCP.
openaec.item7: You want to support open source or contribute to development yourself.

competitor.title: Choose AutoCAD LT if...
competitor.item1: You work with offices that rely on AutoCAD-specific objects, plugins or DWG versions after 2018.
competitor.item2: You need advanced 2D functionality built into the established AutoCAD workflow.
competitor.item3: You need access to Autodesk's extensive plug-in and template ecosystem.
competitor.item4: You need commercial support, training and certification.
competitor.item5: Your organization has worked in AutoCAD workflows for years with deep investment in macros.
competitor.item6: You prefer maximum stability and feature completeness over cost savings.
